# Top-level help, version, errors, and command help are available without a board.
exec weft$exe
stdout 'weft — deterministic product-board operations'
! stderr .+

exec weft$exe -h
stdout 'Usage:'
exec weft$exe --help
stdout 'Maintain:'
exec weft$exe help
stdout 'Use "weft <command> --help"'

exec weft$exe version
stdout 'weft dev'
exec weft$exe --version
stdout 'weft dev'

! exec weft$exe unknown-command
stderr 'weft: unknown command "unknown-command"'
! stdout .+

! exec weft$exe --root
stderr 'weft: --root requires a path and command'
! exec weft$exe --root=somewhere
stderr 'weft: --root requires a command'
! exec weft$exe init --root
stderr 'weft init: --root requires a path'
! exec weft$exe init --root=
stderr 'weft init: --root requires a path'

exec weft$exe list --help
stdout 'List tasks in board order'
exec weft$exe add -h
stdout 'Create a task with a stable number and ID'
exec weft$exe find --help
stdout 'Find task candidates'
exec weft$exe meta --help
stdout 'Read or change flat user-defined task metadata'
